response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(amount - spent) as overall_average FROM budget), status_avg AS (SELECT event_status, AVG(amount - spent) as status_average FROM budget GROUP BY event_status) SELECT status_avg.event_status, status_avg.status_average, status_avg.status_average - overall_avg.overall_average as difference_from_overall FROM status_avg, overall_avg WHERE overall_avg.overall_average IS NOT NULL
